status: Designed — blocked on article implementation (human input pending)
target: Free Rate Scan CTA on knowledge article
hypothesis: Placing the scan CTA directly after the quotation checklist (inline) in addition to the global footer CTA will increase the share of engaged article readers who click through to the fulfilment scan.
control: Current single global CTA section at article end.
variant: Add an inline CTA immediately after the checklist section (cta_location=checklist) plus keep the global footer CTA (cta_location=footer). Same approved label and route.
unit_of_randomisation: Eligible browser assigned once via first-party cookie
metric_definition: Unique eligible sessions with free_rate_scan_cta_click divided by unique eligible sessions with knowledge_article_view
baseline_status: Blocked — knowledge page events do not exist yet; instrumentation is part of the article implementation.
baseline_value: N/A — do not report 0%; events unavailable until Phase 4 implementation.
baseline_window: Collect 14 consecutive days after event QA and article go-live, before variant launch.
baseline_data_quality: knowledge_article_view → quotation_checklist_view progression; cta_click → rate_scan_start progression; scan completion rate by cta_location.
secondary_metrics: Article pagespeed/UX must not degrade; no material drop in valid-lead rate; sample ratio near 50/50; mobile rendering passes QA.
guardrails: GA4/GTM events: knowledge_article_view, quotation_checklist_view, free_rate_scan_cta_click (with cta_location, destination_url, article_slug), plus existing rate_scan_start/rate_scan_complete. Never send PII or form answers. Persist UTM + landing_page with the lead for reconciliation.
tracking_plan: Source landing page; device; channel; new vs returning; checklist_view vs no-checklist_view.
analysis_segments: Staff and agency traffic; automated tests; bots/honeypot; duplicate events; test submissions; sessions without valid assignment.
exclusions: At least 14 full days; fixed sample computed from measured baseline at α=0.05, 80% power, 20% relative MDE.
minimum_run: Fixed sample decided before launch; no early stopping on apparent lift; max 42 days, else inconclusive.
stopping_rule: Ship variant only if two-sided 95% CI for absolute CTA click-through lift excludes zero and relative lift ≥10% with guardrails green; otherwise keep control.
decision_rule: Use only register-approved CTA label (Check your EU fulfilment fit) and route (/fulfilment-scan/). Events added with the article implementation (Phase 4).
